verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, not a software product with items a user can select and act on, so 'bulk operations across many items' is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships such a capability. Ryzen Master's multiple tuning profiles and one-click overclocking are configuration features, not bulk item operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
